scope: packs/delivery-testing read surface: PACK.md, CHECKS.md, guides/, refs/, exemplars/. research/ excluded, because it is the pre-import record and not a read surface.

method.expression: Mechanical scan of the read surface for quoted spans of twelve characters or more, then a read of every passage that restates a source under a no-derivatives or all-rights-reserved licence. No source was re-fetched, so no passage was diffed against its original. This finds carried quotation and close restatement of the passages we already knew were at risk. It cannot find carried expression from a source nobody flagged.
method.licences: Every EV id cited in the read surface was read out of registry/evidence.json and sorted by whether its licence line carries a licence_evidence field. A licence_evidence line is a recorded fact: somebody looked at the page and wrote down what it said. A licence value with no evidence line is an assertion, whatever it says.

expression_findings.finding: Two quoted spans in the read surface, both self-referential rather than carried: a definition of the word partly in CHECKS.md, and a code token in refs/CONTRACT_SUITES.md. Nothing quoted from a source.

The highest-risk restatements were read in full. WG-DEL-005 restates the test-double taxonomy from EV-0184 and EV-0185, both all rights reserved with no reuse licence stated, and the preference order from EV-0187, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. What is carried is the taxonomy and the ordering, which are ideas and facts about a field. The sentences are ours: the guide argues each rung by what it buys and what it costs, which the sources do not do in that form.

refs/QUALITY_SIGNALS.md restates the affordability techniques from EV-0192 as a five-item list. The techniques are the source's findings; the list is our compression and the wording is ours. Same reading for the fit conditions from EV-0091 and EV-0193.

The numbers carried are figures, not expression, and each is attributed at the point of use with its population: 14 against 25 per cent (EV-0007), 73 per cent of faults coupled to a mutant and 27 per cent to nothing (EV-0191), about 38 per cent of surfaced mutants leading to a change (EV-0192), one flaky test in six being a real defect (EV-0195), roughly 4.2 million tests (EV-0196), reporting bands of 80 and 60 with a null break threshold (EV-0190).

One unattributed set of figures was added on 2026-08-10: 104.15, 304.08 and 186.77 bug-revealing tests, in PACK.md under the binding requirements. Its source has no EV id yet and is recorded in packs/delivery-testing/research/sources.fragment.json as FRAG-DELIVERY-TESTING-14. The prose describes the study rather than citing an id that does not exist.
expression_findings.action: Import FRAG-DELIVERY-TESTING-14, deduplicate it against packs/coding/research/sources.fragment.json FRAG-CODING-21, which is the same source, then replace the naming sentence in packs/delivery-testing/PACK.md with the assigned EV id.

evidenced_specific.note: Licence stated on the page and the observation recorded.

evidenced_not_stated.note: Recorded as stating no reuse licence, with the observation recorded. Absence confirmed is a fact, not a gap. Note that EV-0015, EV-0016 and EV-0090 are documentation for a tool whose code is Apache-2.0, and the docs licence is a separate question the record correctly keeps separate.

asserted_specific.note: A specific licence is named and no licence_evidence line backs it. Four matter more than the rest. EV-0184, EV-0185 and EV-0186 are recorded as all rights reserved, which permits fair quotation only, and the pack quotes none of them. EV-0187 and EV-0096 are recorded as CC BY-NC-ND, where the no-derivatives term bears on how closely we may restate them. EV-0194 is recorded as proprietary vendor documentation.

asserted_unknown.note: Recorded as unknown with a parenthetical inference about the publisher's copyright. Two are conference papers read through author-hosted copies, two are Google Testing Blog posts with no reuse licence found on the page, one is vendor documentation. We use their figures and findings, which is fair use of facts, and we quote none of them.

residual: No licence was confirmed during this sweep. ADR-0006 decision 7 forbids re-fetching sources wholesale, and this lane did not fetch any. Every classification above is a reading of what the ledger already records.
16 of 32 cited ids have no licence_evidence line. That is the number to work down.

The pack cites three sources recorded as all rights reserved and two recorded as no-derivatives. None is quoted, so the exposure is restatement rather than reproduction, and the restatements were read and are ours. If any of those five licence lines turns out to be wrong, the exposure does not change, because none of them is quoted either way.
The expression scan cannot prove a negative. It proves no quotation marks and no close restatement in the passages checked.
